assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease.
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered to capture arrhythmic activity during symptomatic periods.
The study will assist in confirming the diagnosis of atrial fibrillation and guiding appropriate rate or rhythm control management.
The payer's denial under Reason Code PR-204 that this service is not covered.
